title: The mystery of the missing tomato
author: Paramita Mukherjee Mullick
text:
A tomato was lost in the International Space Station.
A part of an experiment of air and water grown techniques in plants.
Frank Rubio the astronaut was blamed.
Being in the longest single spaceflight was his claim to fame.
An important scientific research sample was missing.
NASA was desperate to find it out.
Rubio was proud to harvest the first tomato in space.
But it was also his cause of disgrace.
A very special tomato disappeared.
Rubio searched and searched in the 365 feet long space station.
But the precious tomato could not be found.
The one- of- a kind tomato was not around.
At last another astronaut found the tomato.
Jasmin Moghbeli cleared the name of Rubio.
So the tomato was not eaten by him.
It`s a true story although a sci-fi story it might seem.
